D/ CONSTAN TINVS AVG ; R/ GLOR IA EX[ERCITVS]

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), possibly Lyons mint Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN TINVS AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IA EX[ERCITVS]. In exergue: LV[-].
